source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
This model can carry 5 **HERNKYN YAEGIR** models.

As the step in which you Declare Battle Formations begins, you can pick a **HERNKYN YAEGIR** unit of yours that has never been split, and split it into 2 units:

- make the 2 halves as equal in size as possible, and note which models form each
- one half must begin the battle embarked in this **TRANSPORT**
- the second half can begin embarked in another **TRANSPORT**, or be deployed on its own

splitUnit.when: start of the Declare Battle Formations step

otherMay: be deployed as a separate unit
